resolvedSinceRound2.finding: Resolved. Bar 61 is now at 187.020 s, where F-sharp2 rises at 187.01 s (+20 dB) and D-sharp4 at 187.06 s. Its notes follow the measured bands: C-sharp4 187.162 (rise 187.09), F-sharp3 187.682 (187.67), C-sharp3 187.812 (187.81), D-sharp4 189.129 (189.18). The last group, q122, is at 190.680 s (D-sharp4 rise 190.71 s). Bar 60's last group, q120, is at 185.58 s (D-sharp4 rise 185.62 s). The 189.56–191.99 s gap now holds attacks. DTW from Faulkner into Paderewski 1937 at bar 61 is now −0.26 s (round 2: −0.56 s).

Non-blocking; this is the author's disclosed side effect, confirmed. The q103 C-sharp3 (bar 52 +1/2) moved to 145.798 s, against a C-sharp3 rise at 145.97 s (+21 dB). It is 0.17 s early, and it is a single inner note.

Documentation only. Faulkner-to-Prati DTW still differs at bar 59 (+3.52 s) and bar 61 (−1.05 s). Both bars are band-confirmed in both recordings: Faulkner's bar 59 at 177.12 s and bar 61 at 187.01 s; Prati's bar 59 at 197.34–197.36 s and bar 61 at 206.04 s.
